citations.narrative:
The facility does not maintain adequate medical records for the dogs. While reviewing medical records for vaccines there
was 1 adult German Shepherd dog (Raven # 900219001673757) found to not have a current medical record for the
administration of a DAPP/Lepto (7-way) vaccine. The Program of Veterinary Care states that adult dogs will receive the
DAPP/Lepto (7-way) vaccine annually. The facility representative states the vaccine was administered, and this dog is up
to date, but he forgot to document this on a medical record. The last recorded 7-way vaccine for this dog was
administered on 27-August-2024.
Failure to record the names and dates for all treatments administered does not allow for APHIS officials to determine if
adequate veterinary care has been provided for animals covered under the Animal Welfare Act. The licensee must ensure
that the names of all vaccines and treatments administered, and the dates of administration are recorded and maintained.
Correct from this day 17-August-2026 and going forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
